records.Evidence_Description__c: Single-cavity prototype achieved only 11W output vs. 500W target. Pivoting to stacked 10,000-cavity array geometry to achieve power density threshold.
Swarm algorithm demonstrated autonomous assembly at 1/100 scale in lunar regolith simulant. Structural integrity exceeded spec by 22%. Proceeding to full-scale prototype.

Phase-I xenon dosing protocol caused 3.1% neurological degradation in primate trial — outside acceptable limits. Pivoting to protein-lock metabolic anchor to replace xenon as primary suppression agent.
Revised protein-lock protocol achieved zero measurable neurological impact across 60-day primate trial. Metabolic suppression confirmed at 94%. Green light for human-rated prototype.
First-generation graphene sail delaminated at 200 GW/m² laser flux — 40% below operational requirement. Pivoting to carbon nanotube composite substrate for thermal load tolerance.
CNT composite sail withstood 850 GW/m² sustained flux in thermal vacuum chamber with zero delamination. Achieved 0.0008c in 1/1000-scale ground analog. Cleared for full demo.
Entangled photon pair fidelity reached 99.3% across simulated 3.8 AU link. Zero-latency state correlation confirmed. Proceeding to space-qualified hardware production.
Space-qualified relay module passed all thermal, radiation, and vibration qualifications. Final exam passed. Transition authority notified and integration planning initiated.
250 kN sustained thrust confirmed at 11,800 ISP during 90-day continuous burn test at Stennis. Mars transit modeled at 39 days. Full fielding approved.
Post-fielding operational assessment: TITAN-equipped mission reduced transit time by 61% vs. chemical baseline. Crew exposure to cosmic radiation reduced by 44% due to faster transit.
